caption: The drawing consists of a vertical rectangular sheet with a decorative design in the upper two-thirds and a block of German text in the lower third. The design uses primarily red, orange, brown, black, and green hues. At the top center, there is a circular motif resembling a flower or wheel, with a ring of small ovals and a radiating segmented pattern inside. Directly below this, suspended in the middle, is a red heart shape with German text written inside. On either side of the heart are two large, symmetrical eye-like motifs featuring alternating curved and line patterns colored in red, black, and white, each surrounded by multiple small leaf and teardrop shapes in blue, green, orange, and brown. Above each eye motif is a stylized tulip flower with pointed petals filled with red, green, and brown. Additional curved leaves and floral shapes in similar colors fill in around the main forms, especially to the left and right. Below the heart is another eye-like motif, and beneath it, the text is set within a bordered box. The text consists of German script in both black and red ink, with portions underlined, framed with a blue border, and filling most of the lower portion of the composition. The background of the entire sheet has a light tan color with a faint vertical stripe texture.
title: Pa. German Birth Certificate
